subject: Service availability: proposed curative bundle and one-time account gesture
messages:
From: Peter Huang <peter@foliage.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production impact this morning — request for accommodation

Hi Kimberly,

We saw a sustained 30–40% request failure rate across our evaluation workload from ~02:40–03:15 PST this morning (our ticket 87642). That window caused our nightly batch to miss SLA for several downstream services and generated alerts across the analytics team.

We appreciate Redwood's note on the incident, but given the customer-impacting nature and that we ramp to paid usage next week, we'd like to discuss a one-time account gesture (credits + trial stretch) while we finish onboarding. Can you route me to the right person to approve?

Thanks,
Peter Huang
Head of Engineering
Foliage Analytics
--
Peter Huang
peter@foliage.ai

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Peter Huang <peter@foliage.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact this morning — request for accommodation

Thanks for flagging this, Peter — I'm sorry for the disruption. I'm looping in Marissa (account lead) and Stephanie (ops) so we can assess what a fair, quick remediation looks like. We'll review the incident logs and come back with a concrete proposal by EOB Monday.

As a first step, can you confirm the billing account name (is it "Foliage Analytics — Sandbox" or the production account)? Also, if you'd share any sample failing request IDs, that will help ops triage faster.

Appreciate the patience — we'll move quickly on this.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: incident review + suggested package

Team — quick ops readout from the incident logs (see attached incident_logs_20271127.zip and SLADashboard.png):
- Root cause: brief autoscaler regression under a specific burst pattern; error responses were 502s from a proxy layer for ~35 minutes.
- Impact: Foliage's nightly batch hit ~38% failed requests in window; estimated downstream retransmissions added ~20% latency to their pipeline.

Suggested customer gesture (curative bundle):
1) One-time credit equal to 5 days of average daily usage (estimated ~12k tokens worth).
2) 14-day trial extension for their onboarding quota (to cover the disrupted window and give time to finish validation).
3) Priority triage hours (3 hours of dedicated support with an engineer) to smooth the final migration.

This package balances goodwill with precedent. If Sales wants to soften or amplify (e.g., larger credit), flag here. I'll prep a short PDF proposal for approval and include links to the incident artifacts.

—Stephanie
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: incident review + suggested package

Kim, Stephanie — this looks good. Jonathan, want to confirm approval for the proposed curative bundle for Foliage (DEAL-2027-4491)? Quick note on precedent: we typically approve up to 7 days equivalent for a single incident for accounts in onboarding. 

Jonas — if you approve, I'll send the formal PDF (proposal-curative-bundle.pdf) and cc procurement to expedite. Also propose offering a one-week discounted overage window (10% off next month) as an optional add-on.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: incident review + suggested package

Approved.

Please proceed with the following:
- Send the curative bundle PDF to Peter + procurement and include the 14-day extension, the one-time credit (5 days), and 3 hours priority triage.
- Offer the optional one-week 10% overage discount if they opt in.
- Record the action in HubSpot (link in metadata) and update the Zendesk ticket.

Marissa — take the lead on outreach (I trust your phrasing). Stephanie — be available for the triage session once they accept.

Thanks.

—Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
